_doc: Per-chunk physical blocking. Drafted by the local VLM (tools/vlm_blocking.py, goldfishbowl qwen3-vl-32b-heretic / 'literal' = sweep winner) then hand-edited. Grounded in the source stills. motion[] only carries 'static' and cannot express 'lounging', so this file supplies the real blocking. Keep the 'ONLY these N, stay in place' clause.
S05-c01: Only Teegra and Tutor are present, and both remain in the royal bedchamber the whole time. Teegra sits low and lounges back on a cushioned couch, relaxed and listening; Tutor stands beside her, teaching. Nobody walks or moves toward the camera.
S05-c02: Only Teegra and Tutor are present, and both remain in the royal bedchamber the whole time. Teegra reclines on the cushioned couch, relaxed, reading; Tutor stands beside her with one arm raised, teaching. Nobody walks or moves toward the camera.
S05-c03: Only Teegra and Tutor are present, and both remain in the royal bedchamber the whole time. Teegra reclines on a chaise lounge, relaxed and at ease; Tutor sits facing her, talking. Nobody walks or moves toward the camera.
S05-c04: Only Teegra and Tutor are present, and both remain in the royal bedchamber the whole time. Teegra lies back on the couch with her arms stretched above her head, entirely relaxed; Tutor sits in profile beside her, talking. Nobody walks or moves toward the camera.
S03-c01: Only Juliana and Nekron are present, alone in the icy throne hall. Juliana stands facing Nekron in medium close-up; Nekron stands facing her. Both remain in place; nobody walks or moves toward the camera.
S03-c02: Only Juliana and Nekron are present, alone in the icy throne hall. Nekron is seated on the throne, turned slightly toward the camera; Juliana stands facing him with one hand raised in a gesture. Both remain in place; nobody walks or moves toward the camera.
G03-c02:
In the first frame, three figures are visible: one woman and two large, muscular men. The woman is standing and facing forward, with her arms slightly raised, while the two men flank her, also standing and facing forward; one holds an axe, the other a spear. The setting is a dark, dense jungle with large, gnarled trees and foliage.

In the second frame, five figures are visible: the same woman, now centered and standing with arms outstretched, and four muscular men surrounding her, all standing and facing forward. The environment remains the same dark jungle.

In the third frame, only the woman is visible, lying on her back on the jungle floor, viewed from above. She is reclining/lounging, with her legs slightly bent and arms at her sides. The jungle background is unchanged.
